senses.gloss:
mn. (-पः-पं)
A water jar.
m. (-पः)
The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea cadamba.)
E.
नि continuative particle, पा to drink, affix क.

m. (-पः)
1 The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea kadamba.)
2 A species of Ixora, (I. bandhuca, Rox.)
3 A sort of Aśoca or Nil Asoka.
E.
णी to obtain, (pleasure,) and प Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ठः)
Reading, studying or lecturing.
E.
नि before पठ to read, affix अप्; also with ल्युट्, निपठनं.

m. (-ठः)
Reading, study of the sacred books, or public perusal of popular poems.
E.
नि before पठ to read, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Read, studied.
E.
नि, पठ to read, क्त aff.

f. (-तिः)
Reading, study.
E.
नि, पठ to read, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्)
1 Falling, falling down, prostrating.
2 Alighting.
E.
नि before पत to fall, affix शतृ.

n. (-नं)
1 Falling.
2 Alighting, descending.
E.
नि in or on, पत to go, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Causing to descend or fall, throwing down.
2 Beating, knocking down.
3 Killing.
4 (In Grammar,) Irregularity, exception.
E.
नि before पत to fall, in the causal form, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Fallen, fallen down.
2 Alighted, descended.
E.
नि in or on, पत to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Beaten down, made to fall or descend.
2 Killed.
3 Irregular, excepted.
E.
नि before पत to fall, causal form, affix क्त.

ind.
1 Having fallen down, prostrate.
2 Having alighted.
E.
नि before पत to fall, ल्यप् aff.

f. (-त्या)
1 A field of battle.
2 Any plashy or slippery ground.
E.
नि in, पत to fall, affix क्यप्.

m. (-कः)
Cooking, maturing, ripening.
E.
नि before पच to cook, affix घञ्.

m. (-तः)
1 Death, dying.
2 Falling, coming down, alighting.
3 Irregularity, (in Grammar,)
4 A particle, (in ditto.)
E.
नि before पत to go, affix घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 A through or ditch near a well for watering cattle.
2 A well.
3 Any reservoir of water.
4 A milk pail.
5 Drinking, imbibing.
E.
नि before पा to drink, ल्युट् affix; also with कन् added, निपानक n. (-कं)

n. (-नं)
1 Squeezing, pressing.
2 Embracing.
3 Hurting, giving pain.
E.
नि before पीड to give pain, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Squeezed, pressed.
2 Embraced.
3 Pained, hurt.
E.
नि before पीड to give pain, affix क्त.

ind.
1 Having pressed or squeezed, having pressed against or upon.
2 Having embraced.
3 Having hurt.
E.
नि before पीड to pain, and ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Drank, drank up.
2 Absorbed, imbibed, dried up.
E.
नि before पा to drink, क्त aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being drank.
E.
नि before पा to drink, pass. form, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Clever, skilful, conversant.
E.
नि before पुण to be pure, affix क.
